acceptance_criteria.criterion: For this corrective PR only: authorize-prepare must pass the authorization document to authorize.prepare as the bytes it already is, for both the label-event and remediation paths.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: scripts/hunter_issue_agent_lifecycle.py no longer calls document.encode(); tests/test_issue_agent_lifecycle_authorize_prepare.py runs the real cmd_authorize_prepare body for both sources and failed with AttributeError before the fix.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: For this corrective PR only: the execute subcommand must forward the model command after --model-argv unchanged and must not let argparse abbreviate or reinterpret its options.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: parse_arguments splits argv at the first --model-argv; tests/test_issue_agent_lifecycle_cli_contract.py parses every real lifecycle invocation in the five workflows and failed before the fix. This does not claim Issue #574 is complete: no hosted run past authorize is proven.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: For this corrective PR only: collector-complete must end an exhausted reviewer pool as a non-blocking, authority-free REVIEWER_UNAVAILABLE state only when the receipt exactly matches the trusted PR, head, run, claims, generation and pool configuration, and must leave clear/blocking verdicts and malformed, partial, stale or mixed receipts alone.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: tests/test_review_orchestrator_collector_finalization.py (64 tests) covers matching, malformed, partial, stale-generation, changed-head, duplicate, concurrent and terminal-state cases. It is validated by unit tests only; its live effect begins after merge.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: For this corrective PR only: the Merge Readiness success description must not claim the independent-review opportunity is terminal unless a review completed or the opportunity was exhausted under the approved policy, without changing any readiness predicate.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: review_disposition_phrase derives the wording from the observed review-authority state; tests in tests/test_hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py cover completed, exhausted, pending and not-requested, assert the 140-character status limit, and assert the decision state is identical across all of them.

defect_families.evidence: UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No authorization is minted or replayed differently. F1 passes the already-signed authorization bytes to authorize.prepare unchanged; the authorize_prepare tests assert the bytes are not re-encoded and exactly one authorization source is accepted. The collector change signs nothing.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No evidence artifact or digest is introduced. The collector finalization verifies the receipt's pr, full head, run, claims, generation and pool-configuration digest against trusted values before believing any field (tests: stale/mixed/malformed identity cases).

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No write channel or writer authentication changes. The one new publisher is the trusted default-branch collector run already holding statuses:write; read_cycle believes its status only for REVIEWER_UNAVAILABLE, from a workflow_dispatch run on the default branch, by github-actions[bot].

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No writer or principal resolution is touched. Every commit in the range is authored and committed by the policy-authorized signer claude and was reported verified/valid by GitHub when checked.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: The candidate is a linear range of signed commits on main@0a0923b; no rewind, amend of pushed history or force-push is used.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No connector receipt is written, consumed or renamed. The review request is regenerated by the existing tool as the last content-binding step and the push goes through .githooks/pre-push.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: This document is only the author's content-bound claim set, generated by hunter_pre_ready_review.py --request. It carries no authority. Exact-head authority must come from an authenticated reviewer through the collector; on the previous head no reviewer produced any, and that is recorded as reviewer unavailability, not as a clear.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: A still-running prerequisite is not reported as failure by this change. Finalization is skipped (not failed) when the request, cycle or receipt is not yet usable, and Merge Readiness predicates are untouched.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No prevention stage is promoted. DFF-046 gains regression evidence and a source note; its lifecycle stays regression-tested. The new wording in Merge Readiness states only what was observed (completed, exhausted under policy, pending, not requested) and no longer says an unrequested review was terminal.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No validation proof is stored or reused. The full proof is the hosted exact-head Hunter / Pre-PR Preflight, run separately for each pushed head.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No issuer, volume or bootstrap code is touched.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No execution-ledger ownership or lease code is touched.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No worker, shutdown or drain code is touched.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: Merge Readiness predicates and required checks are unchanged: only the success description is derived differently, and a test asserts every review-authority state still yields the same decision state. Current-head review authority handling in review_authority_state is not modified.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: authorize.prepare still validates Source Handling before any ledger claim; F1 only stops re-encoding the document passed into it.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: Remediation generations are respected, not widened: finalization requires the receipt generation and the open cycle generation to equal the trusted current generation, and never starts another generation (stale-generation tests).

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No authority cutover is made. TRUSTED publisher membership is not widened to the collector in general: read_cycle accepts a collector-run status only for REVIEWER_UNAVAILABLE and only from a default-branch workflow_dispatch run.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: External reviewers stay optional and non-blocking. The new state is non-blocking, projects as success, mints no review authority, and is published only when every enabled authority reviewer recorded no review; a substantive clear or blocking verdict is never converted.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: No publication path is added or bypassed. Pushes go through .githooks/pre-push; the full pytest proof runs once in the hosted exact-head Pre-PR Preflight; the Issue Agent candidate-PR opener is untouched.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: All changed files are ordinary tracked paths loaded by their consumers; the registry JSON loads and the defect-prevention and artifact guards pass locally.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: The new tests use in-process fixtures and the tracked reviewer pool and workflow files only; no network, Issue-body or remote-state call is made in the deterministic lane.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: The authoritative verdict remains the commit-status state; only prose in the description changed, and a test pins that the decision state is identical for every review-authority input.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: This change edits trusted controller logic (orchestrator and Merge Readiness), which runs from the default branch, so it cannot be exercised live from this branch. It is validated by focused unit tests and by the Trusted Orchestrator Replay on the candidate modules; its live effect begins only after merge. Not claimed as live-proven.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: The synchronize/ready handoff to the privileged orchestrator is unchanged; this change only adds finalization at collector completion and leaves reconcile as the backstop.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: The reviewer-chain budget is still derived from the pool (independent_review_opportunity_seconds is unchanged). Finalization trusts only the per-reviewer budgets the collector itself recorded and re-checks them against the pool (early timeout/ack claims are rejected).

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: Finalization never dispatches a collector (the tests make dispatch_collector raise) and never publishes over a non-open cycle, so at most one dispatch identity per PR, head, generation and pool configuration is still minted by ensure_collector.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: Only the sources and regression_evidence arrays of DFF-046 were extended; title, invariant, lifecycle and prevention text compiled into prompts are unchanged. The hosted full suite owns the prompt-budget tests; they were not run locally.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: This is the repair for a recurrence of the family: a configured workflow_run trigger from a dispatched collector to reconcile was never delivered, so an exhausted pool stayed pending. collector-complete now ends the cycle itself. Remaining gap, stated plainly: a collector that dies before collector-complete still depends on a later reconcile pass for REVIEW_TIMED_OUT; that case is not guaranteed.

UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: Acknowledgement semantics are unchanged: an unacknowledged Codex or Copilot request is treated as no review, never as provider execution, and only a complete receipt of such outcomes can exhaust the pool.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: Merge execution is not touched. The push is verified against the remote and PR head after pushing.
UNVERIFIED AUTHOR CLAIM: Unresolved-review-thread and changes-requested handling in Merge Readiness is not modified.
